login.title: Login
login.subtitle: Enter your credentials to access your account
login.genericError: Could not sign in. Please try again.
login.chooseClubSubtitle: Your account works in several clubs
login.noClubs: This account has no access to any club
login.noAccessToClub: You have no access to the club “{club}”

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email you sign in with. We will send a link to set a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account with this email exists, we have sent a link. It is valid for 1 hour — check your inbox and spam folder.

resetPassword.title: New password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account
resetPassword.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit
resetPassword.success: Password changed. All other sessions have been signed out.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

errors.passwordRule: Needs an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit

confirmEmail.title: Email confirmation
confirmEmail.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has already been used. If your email is already confirmed, just sign in.
confirmEmail.resendNeedsLogin: Sign in to send the letter again.
confirmEmail.bannerText: We sent a letter with a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to confirm the address.

status.creatingAccountDescription: We are creating your club member profile and preparing secure access.
status.uploadingDocumentsDescription: Your documents and signature are being queued for secure private processing.
status.uploadErrorDescription: Your member account is already created, but document upload failed. Retry now.

portalRegister.title: Club sign-up
portalRegister.subtitle: Your club and owner account — CRM access opens right away
portalRegister.slugHelp: It will appear in the CRM address: {url}
portalRegister.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit
portalRegister.acceptTerms: I accept the <terms>Terms and conditions</terms> and the <dpa>Data processing agreement</dpa>, and I have read the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>

errors.slugChars: Latin letters, digits and hyphens only
errors.passwordRule: Needs an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit
errors.acceptTerms: Accept the terms to create the club

join.title: Join {club}
join.subtitle: Fill in the club's form. If the club has already created an account for this email, the password activates it.
join.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit
join.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired.

errors.password: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit

done.title: Done!
done.checkEmail: You are in {club}. We have sent you an email with a confirmation link — open it to activate the account.
done.existing: You are in {club}. Sign in with your usual password.
